description: Record a pre-check of one exact Offer only once the user agrees to it, never as a side step of another action. With reaffirm permission, offer it when the user asks whether an Offer fits or after you show them one. It checks one exact Offer version against the user's current intent and records your answer: fits (validated), needs_user (you must ask the user first, for example a price above their stated limit or a changed term) or does_not_fit (the Offer stops counting for this buyer). Optionally add reason_code and a short note. Pass the Offer and Request versions you read; a newer version makes the answer stale. fits requires a current prepared Offer free of hard-term, cost and expiry blockers. With no price limit on file, the price is the user's call: if they say the Offer fits, record fits. Price never rejects an answer: stored price limits are the user's intent, used for matching and labels (see demand.price_position and above_confirmed_limit_by_minor), not authorization. This grants no price, spending, payment authority; Popular Demand is a broker and spending authority stays with the user, you and their wallet or payment method. Restate or narrow the user's conditions; ask before widening price, quantity or hard terms. Not an acceptance, order or payment. Requires reaffirm permission and the user's confirmation.

expected_offer_version.description: The Offer version you last read.

expected_request_version.description: The Request version you last read.

note.description: Optional short private note for the user. Never include payment details.

reason_code.description: Optional main reason for needs_user or does_not_fit.

request_key.description: Your key for this change; the same key repeats it safely.

user_confirmed.description: True: the user said yes to this exact change.

verdict.description: fits: this exact Offer version matches the user's current intent as you understand it. needs_user: you must ask the user before deciding (for example a price above their stated limit, or a changed term). does_not_fit: it does not match; the Offer stops counting for this buyer.

name: validate_offer

demand.description: Derived demand state: potential (fits the outcome), validated (the buyer agent's latest pre-check of this exact Offer version said fits), needs_user (the agent must ask the user), committed (an authorized card payment, only on an Offer made while Popular Demand offered payment holds). not_counted means no current claim, never a refusal unless reasons say the agent declined. Price position is a label, never a gate.

title: Pre-check an Offer
